scope: Independent local public source/metadata preflight. No tests, hardware, network, credentials, private logs, Git or source/plan changes.

delta_review.continuation: Completed bounded streams retain actual tx/rx/timing/pair counts. Deficits append per-stream QualificationFailure and qualifyingFalse, then collect other planned streams/recoveries while unchanged identity, station authorization, session, peer, ownership and deadline gates continue. No stream repeat or rescoring.
delta_review.fatal_acquisition: Output-bound excess, unparseable ping summary, ping nonzero/stderr, capture nonzero, startup/deadline/ownership/peer/session failures still raise and restore.
delta_review.final_gate: Exact epoch keys0..4 and exact four labels each; every row qualifyingTrue, no reasons, tx32/rx32/reply_timings32/pairs>=32. stream_quality establishes finite nonnegative timing values before qualifyingTrue. Require occurs before multicycle_pass; final status additionally requires no recorded failures and no cleanup errors.
delta_review.evidence_order: Every raw ping/capture artifact archived before stream_quality; deficits preserved in counts/reasons and aggregatedfailures. Native120/60/780 gates, original20streams, captures45/48/5s, holds, four new target sessions, peer continuity and full restoration unchanged.

verification.preserved_test_failure: 136PASS/1FAIL archive-order AST expectation preserved. Fixture now checks archive precedes relocated stream_quality call; not represented as RF or pre-fix wireless proof.

limits: Admission permits prospective continuation of planned observations after bounded packet deficits; it never turns those deficits into success. Any QualificationFailure still blocks final PASS.
No new RF recipe, extra load, CPE command, stabilization delay, stream retry or widened deadline. XC quiet-policy effect remains unknown until observed physically.
A completed recovery matrix with traffic deficits must remain NOT_ACCEPTED; per-recovery positives cannot substitute for all five complete traffic/hold epochs.
Controller/native/observer timing and immediate-mode causality are not proven by local tests. No production or universal zero-touch claim.
